note: Site layout for build_fast.py. sections: order = nav/page order; songs whose collection matches a section are added to it (new ones after the listed order). cards: per-song display overrides; new songs can omit them.

sections.title: 💫 Power Ballads Reimagined
sections.blurb: Thirty new songs, each built on the mechanics of one of the thirty most popular power ballads released from the 1980s to 2020, in rock, metal, pop, soul and R&B, and written from the point of view of someone who has lived a few more decades than the original singer had. All original lyrics.

sections.title: 🤠 Pop-Country Reimagined
sections.blurb: Thirty new songs, each built on the hook mechanics of a 2000–2026 pop-country crossover and written as a fresh original. Story songs, duets and summer anthems, all original lyrics.

sections.title: ✝️ Christian Pop Reimagined
sections.blurb: Thirty new songs about Jesus, each built on the hook mechanics of one of the most popular Christian songs of the streaming era and recast in a genre people already love. Every one is written so you are halfway through before you realize it. All original lyrics.

sections.title: 📼 70s Reimagined
sections.blurb: Twenty brand-new originals, each built on the hook mechanics of one of the most enduring songs of the 1970s and written from today's point of view. Glam rock, soft rock, disco, funk, Southern rock, folk and soul sounds, all original lyrics.

sections.title: 📼 90s Reimagined
sections.blurb: Twenty brand-new originals, each built on the hook mechanics of one of the most enduring songs of the 1990s and written from today's point of view. Grunge, Britpop, hip-hop, teen pop, power ballads and Eurodance sounds, all original lyrics.

sections.title: 📼 80s Reimagined
sections.blurb: Twenty brand-new originals, each built on the hook mechanics of one of the most enduring songs of the 1980s and written from today's point of view. New wave, synth-pop, arena rock, sophisti-pop and hair-metal sounds, all original lyrics.

sections.title: Halloween
sections.blurb: A monster dance-craze novelty song plus two long trick-or-treat haunted-house soundtracks full of jump-scare surprises, and three no-music sound-effects ambiences (graveyard, crypt, haunted playground).

sections.title: Minimum Payment
sections.blurb: A concept album of hard industrial techno about modern economic dread: debt, rent, the grind, AI, burnout, the feed, and the unwritten future.

sections.title: Faith Pop
sections.blurb: Uplifting Christian music, from bright dance-pop to soulful gospel, Southern gospel hymns and dark Christian EBM.

sections.title: Dark Electro
sections.blurb: Ten dark, driving electro tracks: neon highways, cold synths and robot funk.

sections.title: Sacred Trance
sections.blurb: Ten meditative trance pieces with chants, world instruments and ambient space.

sections.title: Chill House Playlist
sections.blurb: A ten-track chill house set with warm grooves and lounge textures.

sections.title: Singles
sections.blurb: Early one-offs: club house, EDM, synthwave, industrial EBM, Enigma-style chant and poolside chill.
